Maya (partnerships): Starting canonical thread for GulfStream (new EU hub) onboarding with CumulusCloud + EdgeWorks SI. Customer beta goal 2025-01-15. Need capacity carveout, marketplace SKU, KMS attestation, and joint PR timing.
Ibrahim (partner-eng): Cumulus can reserve 10x H100s in AMS colo; proposing 6x dedicated for Redwood. They want a signed capacity attachment by Dec 10.
Suki (ops): Ops asks: please confirm expected steady rps and max context. Also need partner metering endpoint for sandbox tests.
Rahul (eng): ML perf: steady 50 rps, burst 160 rps, context up to 4096. Will run int8 where possible. Need 48h prewarm before beta.
Ibrahim (partner-eng): Marketplace SKU idea: CUMULUS-GS-H100-6-DED. Ill submit draft to marketplace tracker.
EdgeSI-bot: EdgeWorks runbook ticket EW-902 created: VPN, certs, smoke tests.
Vera (security): Note: no partner-managed KMS for customer keys. Acceptable: HSM passthrough with attestation or customer-managed KMS. Please share certs and threat model by Dec 20.
Tess (legal): For any co-marketing we need logo usage terms + 5 business days for PR review. Drop draft copy at least a week before external date.
Maya (partnerships): Owners: Ibrahim - capacity PO (Dec 10); Suki - metering tests (Dec 22); Rahul - perf + prewarm (Jan 13); Vera/Tess - security/legal checks (Dec 20). React with :white_check_mark: if you accept.
Suki (ops): Accepting metering tests. Ill schedule sandbox window Dec 26-28.
Rahul (eng): Accepting perf/prewarm. Will post harness later today.
Ibrahim (partner-eng): Will send PO template and Cumulus attestation by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (partnerships): Great. Weekly sync Fridays 08:00 CET starting Dec 1. Ill update the partnerships board with this thread as the source of truth. Thanks! :rocket:
